summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (SVAQ), a SPAC, filed an 8-K on August 19, 2026, announcing the confidential submission of a draft S-4 registration statement for its previously announced business combination with quantum technology company EigenQ, Inc. The S-4 includes a proxy statement/prospectus for SVAQ shareholder vote. The initial announcement was on June 17, 2026. This is a routine SPAC de-SPAC progress update with no financial terms or valuation disclosed. Watch for the public S-4 filing, shareholder meeting date, and redemption levels, which will drive the deal's completion and post-merger trading.
